title: skills: View All / Modify All no longer open fields in 19 — re-teach objectstack-ai pitfall 2 and the objectstack-data security eval (follow-up of #36055)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As8wf3DSPRevwNnYLcM
Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet · Skills-docs follow-up owed by PR #37371 (#36055)

## What

PR #37371 (#36055, the 19 major, maintainer ruling 7177220994) makes `viewAllRecords` / `modifyAllRecords` cast no field vote; `viewAllFields` is the only "all fields" channel. Two published skill texts teach the old meaning (read by the #36055 dev at its head, report 7178352702):

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, pitfall 2: says Modify All grants a field edit.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`: the expected output says View All and Modify All re-open a field.

## Acceptance

- Both texts teach the 19 meaning (record axis only; `viewAllFields: true` for every field), and the eval's expected output matches.
- Lands after PR #37371 merges, in the same 19 major.

Blocked-by: #36055
Dedupe: searched 'viewAllFields skills', 'Modify All field skills' — no open card.
